lead.headline: Rice is out, Jacobs waits a week — and Los Cachanillas fixed their lineup
lead.deck: They dropped Hurts for Pierce and swapped in the Ravens; your odds fell from 72% to 59%. Daniels is cleared.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. Rashee Rice is out again with his hamstring and knee, and Josh Jacobs comes off the exempt list only on Monday, eligible from Week 7 at Detroit — with the league's review still open. Then the matchup moved: this morning Los Cachanillas were starting an injured Jalen Hurts and a defence on bye; by the afternoon they had added Dameon Pierce and the Ravens. Their projection rose from 85.9 to 110.4 and ESPN now gives you 59%. Your side needs nothing. Washington's Saturday report gave Jayden Daniels no designation after three full practices, so the Stroud fallback is retired, and every starter is clear on the final reports. The lineup as set is the projection lineup, 127.7.
